$jsonSchema.description: Contains information on each on campus food location including hours, sub-stations, and menu items

location.description: contains all information about where this location is actually located

area.description: a general description of where the location is (ex. "Muir College" for Pines or "Price Center, 1st floor" for Santorini)

geodata.description: the GeoJSON object that contains all geodata

stations.description: A list of each station at the dining hall, empty if this location is not a dining hall

items.description: One station at the dining hall

station_id.description: the unique identifier for a station

type.description: The type of location this is: "dining hall", "cafe", "market", or "other"
